usage: 角 (gok3) is used as a noun to refer to the horn of an animal, such as a goat or a bull.
When talking about animals, 角 usually refers to the hard, pointed part growing on the head.
You can use 角 to describe parts of animals in general, for example, ‘the deer has big horns.’
In some cases, 角 can also mean a corner or angle, but when used with animals, it clearly means horn.
It is common to add measure words like 隻 (zek3) for counting horns, e.g., 一隻角 means one horn.
